fusions.name: Clenched Shut
fusions.desc: Closes a fist of bars around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning each for 1 second and leaving it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: No Way Out
fusions.desc: Closes a grip of bars on one enemy up to 6 tiles away for 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Inescapable] for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Laced Fingers
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Firmly in Grasp
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
